ticker.archetype: Southeast Asia superapp: mobility, deliveries, financial services

drivers.name: Core: deliveries, mobility and ads
drivers.thesis: Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines (about 62% of FY2025 revenue) fund the rest; if mobility take rates hold and the deliveries margin keeps rising, adjusted EBITDA compounds faster than revenue.
drivers.notes: Owners' file: about 48% of the 2028 EBITDA lift (Deliveries ~22%, Mobility ~21%, Others ~5%). That is a share of EBITDA lift, not of today's price, so Share of price is left blank (decision 5). Capped by D3 if D3 turns red; translation drag from D6 (Indonesia about 21% of revenue). Six signals kept on purpose (owners 2026-11-08), one over the usual cap of 5; the app shows an 'over cap' tag on this driver.

drivers.name: Financial Services
drivers.thesis: Digital banks in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia (Superbank, consolidated from June 2026) and lending on Grab's transaction data; segment EBITDA turned positive in Q3 2026 and management targets $500M by 2028.
drivers.notes: Owners' file: about 49% of the 2028 EBITDA lift. Share of price left blank (decision 5).

drivers.name: Regulation and competition (take rates)
drivers.thesis: Regulators in Indonesia and Vietnam are compressing mobility take rates, and robotaxis could bypass the marketplace later; a fee cap on cars or delivery in Indonesia is the main way core margins get cut.
drivers.notes: Not separately valued (embedded in D1). A red D3 caps D1 at yellow in the owners' method; the app shows it as a dependency only.

drivers.name: Balance sheet and capital return
drivers.thesis: Net cash and buybacks give a partial floor; the Atome payment (about $1.49B at close) is the main call on cash.
drivers.notes: Owners' file: net cash is about 25-36% of market cap; not used as Share of price.

drivers.name: Atome and the 2028 bridge
drivers.thesis: Atome is the largest single item in the 2028 Financial Services bridge and the least evidenced: five regulators must approve and close is due by Q3 2027.
drivers.notes: Owners' file: about $130M of 2028 FS EBITDA [EST]; Foodpanda Taiwan removed from the bridge after the block. Evidence is thin: one company reiteration of the $1.7B target.

drivers.name: Indonesia macro
drivers.thesis: Indonesia is about 21% of FY2025 revenue and home to Superbank; macro stress is a currency-translation and credit-quality risk, not a 1997-style funding crisis (reserves cover short-term external debt about 1.8x).
drivers.notes: Owners' scenarios (Oct 27 est.): grinding stabilization 55% (rupiah 17,500-18,500), stagnation 35%, crisis 10%. Detail lives in the owners' Indonesia Macro Watch dashboard.
